## Key Projects

1. **Market Mind AI** — Intelligent Stock Market Assistant using LLM-driven RAG pipelines, multimodal AI tools, and CNN-based analysis. Stack: React.js, MongoDB, NLP, LSTM, ML. GitHub: https://github.com/Kawinkawin/Market-Mind.AI

2. **Arogyam.ai** — Personalized Healthcare AI Advisor with role-based access, real-time multilingual chat, and ML-powered consultation. Stack: Python, Flask, MySQL, Google Cloud, Docker. GitHub: https://github.com/Kawinkawin/Arogyam.ai

3. **Dream-PDF** — AI-driven PDF application using BERT for sentiment analysis and RVC model for voice generation. Stack: ReactJS, ExpressJS, Python, Flask, Flutter.

4. **AI Speech Therapy Game** — Interactive AI-powered speech therapy game with gamified progress tracking. Stack: AI/ML, Speech Recognition, Unity, Node.js, MongoDB. GitHub: https://github.com/Kawinkawin/AI-Speech-Therapy-Game

5. **Surveillance System using Vision Transformers** — Real-time surveillance using ViT for object detection and activity monitoring. Stack: Python, PyTorch, ViT, OpenCV. GitHub: https://github.com/Kawinkawin/Surveillance-Using-Vision-Transformers

6. **Text-Summarizer** — Web-based T5 Transformer text summarization app with Flask backend and Streamlit frontend. Stack: Python, Flask, T5, PyTorch, Streamlit.
